boundary: S8 foundational comparison control. Versions 0.1-0.3 were rejected for breadth or incomplete OpenAlex pagination. Version 0.4 achieved complete, precise exports but failed predeclared positive-sentinel recall for plural Story Points, the exact software-developer productivity title, and the queuing-formula spelling. Version 0.5 changes only those prospectively documented lexical variants and requires fresh exports and appraisals. Method and instrument records remain in the method/reference stratum and are not GenAI primary studies. Developmental only; not a frozen search, screening decision, eligibility decision, PRISMA input, or empirical support for VDCM.

sentinels.title: Story points changes in agile iterative development
sentinels.rationale: Empirically demonstrates that Story Point estimates can change with evolving work-item information and bounds reliability assumptions.

sentinels.title: Software developers' perceptions of productivity
sentinels.rationale: Foundational evidence that developer productivity includes task completion, interruptions, and context switching rather than code output alone.

sentinels.title: Expectations, outcomes, and challenges of modern code review
sentinels.rationale: Foundational socio-technical evidence that review includes understanding, knowledge transfer, and team awareness as well as defect finding.

sentinels.title: NASA-Task Load Index (NASA-TLX); 20 Years Later
sentinels.rationale: Defines the retrospective multidimensional subjective-workload comparator, not an ex-ante capacity estimator.

sentinels.title: A Proof for the Queuing Formula: L = lambda W
sentinels.rationale: Foundational queueing identity used only under its assumptions for flow interpretation.

sentinels.title: Relative estimates of software development effort: Are they more accurate or less time-consuming to produce than absolute estimates, and to what extent are they person-independent?
sentinels.rationale: Tests benefits and person-independence of relative estimates, preventing an assumed-failure or assumed-superiority narrative.

sentinels.title: Workload and Performance: Associations, Insensitivities, and Dissociations
sentinels.rationale: Constrains any inference that workload and task performance are interchangeable constructs.

sentinels.title: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration-task load index: NASA-TLX: evaluation of its use in surgery
sentinels.rationale: A workload study outside software engineering; retrieval is a precision warning rather than framework evidence.
